notes.title: Network stability update
notes.notes: Hello! We've pushed a new update to Drunk-Fu: Wasted Masters which improves the connectability & stability of the network side of the game. There are also some edge case crash fixes that improve the overall stability of the game.

notes.title: Release date set: 17th of August
notes.notes:
Hi fellas! We are finally getting ready to ship the game. Since the last release on Early Access we have polished the levels so we have 8 awesome unique bar experiences & three unique game modes for you to enjoy with your friends both Online & Offline.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28298917/e675bbfaaf2327b5ab9decd76c6c26ce8f871a4d.png[/img]

There's also a new pretty Announcement trailer on the Steam-page. Go take a peek and tell us what you think!

We might have also a few surprises coming for the Release-date. Come & join our Discord to tell us what those might be! [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/yJHUB4T]https://discordapp.com/invite/yJHUB4T[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28298917/b9f95cdb72901d6d6beef73ccc9ee80d5f18cd7e.png[/img]

notes.title: Sneaky stability update
notes.notes:
Hey! We’ve did some network code fine tuning so it should be more reliable now. There’s also a new iteration of the chimney level and some minor polishing & bugfixes.

Please note that we are still having some issues with the multiplayer that cause unnecessary lag. We are looking into this to get a hotfix out asap.

Have a safe Juhannus, everyone! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28298917/81ec297395f995263915afdfeef30196a241a1fd.png[/img]

notes.title: Drunken may update!
notes.notes:
We are getting closer to getting Drunk-Fu: Wasted Masters in shape! A new build has been uploaded and it has lots of tweaks. The gameplay is getting quite close to what we want it to be in the final release. Couple of game modes still missing, but those need some extra care before we get them to you guys!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28298917/9e5bd0fafde56ee576e7e7b2dfe02238c9ec1fdc.png[/img]

Six of the eight levels coming for the release are quite polished. Do tell us which ones are your favorites and what more you’d like!

Short video showcasing the levels: [url=https://youtu.be/NK9dPXRmsqQ]https://youtu.be/NK9dPXRmsqQ[/url]

Join our Discord server: [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/yJHUB4T]https://discordapp.com/invite/yJHUB4T[/url]

New features:
[list]
[*] Completely redone Diner-level!
[*] Completely redone Saloon-level!
[*] Completely redone Chimney-level!
[*] Heavy attack direction indicator
[*] Completely new soundtracks for the levels (some levels still pending, sorry!)[/list]

Fixes & tweaks
[list]
[*] Iterated visual effects
[*] Multiplayer handling is more robust
[*] Adjusted Goon collider sizes for funnier combat
[*] Level polish & performance optimization all around
[*] D-pad now moves the character
[*] General combat tweakage for more Impact
[*] Improved user handling
[*] Multiplayer should work for up to 8 players now
[*] Added floating to midsummer & beachbar
[*] Fixed crash when pathfinder & AI conflicted in Midsummer
[*] Resized bottles to be of a more reasonable scale
[*] Fixed visual effects to work more properly online
[*] Adjusted punchtrails to fit the new combat system
[*] General stability & performance improvements
[*] Iterated arena-camera system. Feedback welcome!
[/list]

notes.title: GET SMASHED - Drunk-Fu’s new patch
notes.notes:
The new GET SMASHED-patch has been released. Go download it and join our Discord to tell what you think: [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/yJHUB4T]https://discordapp.com/invite/yJHUB4T[/url]

[h1]GET SMASHED! -mode [/h1]
Hits get progressively stronger as the goons take further hits. There is a limited duration and the one who gets most KO’s wins. Players respawn after ring outs. 

[h1]Control iteration[/h1]
Instead of each arm being controlled separately, we have introduced a Fast & Heavy attack system with a dodge on the side. The iteration allows for quite the wacky combos and flying drunk fu.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28298917/4ebd72189152cee3de859112f04de448a291b284.png[/img]
We have also changed the controls to use the front facing buttons. This is still a work in progress, but do tell us what you think of the direction.

[h1]Levels[/h1]
Since the last update we have added the new level Helipad to the game. Beach bar & chimney have also been rebuilt from the ground up and midsummer got some polish on it. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28298917/147bbba53786808cc777adbd30bcf6aa26e30ec8.png[/img]
We have also culled some of the older game modes that got senseless with the system updates - the levels currently only in use in Swarm will be iterated to fit the new system.

[h1]Other tweaks:[/h1]
AI updated to better work with the new system (still suicidal)
Removed healing platforms from levels
Fixed colliders in levels
Network syncing fixes
Reordered levels in the selection menu
Adjusted KO trigger sizes
Fixed crosshair visibilities
Updated game mode descriptions
Updated control maps for loading screen
Updated tips for loading screen
Updated plugins

We are working on Drunk Fu (almost) full time again, so expect more updates to come with a faster pace!

notes.title: New GET SMASHED-patch landing on Friday. Join our Discord!
notes.notes:
Heads up! We are putting a bigger patch out on Friday.

[h1]Upcoming changes:[/h1]
[b]GET SMASHED! -mode [/b]
Hits get progressively stronger as the goons take more hits. There is a limited duration for the game and the one who gets most KO’s wins. Players respawn after ring out. Good & casual mode for the whole family that doesn't penalize too much!

[b]Control iteration:[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28298917/4ebd72189152cee3de859112f04de448a291b284.png[/img]

To improve the overall gameplay we have updated the controls so that the main controls are on the front face of the pad and switched individual hand attacks to a chargeable ‘Heavy’ & a 'Fast’ attack. The aerial combat has also gotten a major revamp. More on this on Friday!

[b]New Helipad-level:[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28298917/147bbba53786808cc777adbd30bcf6aa26e30ec8.png[/img]

We have also done major iteration on the Beachbar & Midsummer levels. The patch also includes major minor improvements all over the place - expect the full patch notes on Friday.

In the coming months we are able to work on Drunk Fu full time again, so expect more updates! Also join us on our Discord for the latest gossip: https://discordapp.com/invite/yJHUB4T

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28298917/25223a4796893ba6c1806cfe94ac05be5af014d8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 11th of July 2017: Powerup Patch
notes.notes:
We just added pickable health & weapon powerups. The weapons have also been adjusted so that they only get destroyed when being used. Full patch notes & details below!
 
Go try the patch out & tell us what you think!
[h1]New features:[/h1]
[list][*]New health indicators
[*]New playername indicator
[*]Health powerups in levels
[*]Weapon powerups in levels
[*]Weapons have durability that’s exhausted by using them

notes.title: 20th of June 2017: Aerial Combat Patch
notes.notes:
The combat in Drunk-Fu: Wasted Masters just got a whole lot better! We added some new moves to make the game easier to approach and clarified when players get dealt damage and when they take it (when they get hit by a glowing fist or a weapon, duh!). 
 
The new Double Jump & Air Dash features greatly improve the maneuverability of the characters and the improved Swarm-mode gives a more enjoyable Single Player experience.
 
Go try the patch out & tell us what you think!

notes.title: 27th of April 'Diner-Patch' Notes
notes.notes:
There’s a new ‘Diner-patch’ out now for you all to enjoy. Main points of the patch are greatly improved controls & a new level. Download the patch now & tell us your thoughts!

[h1]New features:[/h1]
[list][*]Test level: Diner
[*]Alien clothing
[*]Bots were given names
[*]Any-option in matchmaker
[/list] 
[h1]Tweaks:[/h1]
[list][*]Made the characters react less to air friction, thus making aerial combat easier
[*]Connection to matchmaker should not drop so often
[*]If starting a game alone locally, bots will be added to the game
[*]Automatic crash reports to developers
[*]Kills & deaths should be assigned correct players now
[*]Limb specific cooldowns to make button smashing less appealing (indicators in the next patch!)[/list]
[h1]Known issues:[/h1]
[list][*]Matchmaking is region locked
[*]Splash / loading screen becomes occasionally unresponsive & Windows gives the complaint about it. Waiting resolves the problem.
[*]AI cannot handle stairs just yet
[*]Fist trails / indicators for cooldowns are ...lacking
[*]Levels are a work in progress and some rough edges are to be expected
[/list]
